summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the Kampus (Campus) admin feature: 377-campus dataset load, admin CRUD, XLSX import idempotency, student access, Data Pendidikan dropdown + Kampus Lainnya, case-insensitive matching, 403 for student mutations, mobile responsiveness. All 4 pytest cases and all frontend acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1630 lines — split into feature modules (campuses, notifications, admin, auth, site_content) before it grows further.

campuses collection has unique index on code (sparse). Import uses query={'code': code} if code else {'name': name}. If two rows in XLSX share the same name but no code, only the first inserts and second becomes an update — matches idempotency but silently drops distinct rows. Consider raising validation error instead.
CampusField's knownCampus lookup runs O(n) on every render for a 377-item array. Fine now but memoise or index by lowercase-name if campus count grows.

POST /api/campuses returns campus dict but PUT returns {'id', 'name', 'updated_at', 'code': code or None}. Shape inconsistency between endpoints — align return payloads (both should include created_at).
import_campuses reads entire XLSX into memory (5MB limit ok) but processes rows sequentially with per-row DB round-trip. For 400+ rows this is fine, but consider bulk_write for scalability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_campuses.py — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_campuses.py -v -o addopts=''`. Covers: (1) GET /api/campuses returns 377 unique, no _id, includes STIKES RS Husada Jakarta 01-JK1-001; (2) Admin CRUD + duplicate-code/name 400 + GET-verify persistence + delete-verify removal; (3) Re-import /tmp/cms-masa-depan-jakarta.xlsx is idempotent (inserted=0, total stays 377); (4) Student receives 403 on POST/PUT/DELETE/import. Frontend verified via Playwright at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: admin /admin route menu-kampus opens CampusManager showing '377 kampus terdaftar'; full add→edit→search→delete flow succeeds with POST 200, PUT 200, DELETE 200 (verified via response interception). Student /dashboard menu-daftar → Data Pendidikan → field-institusi is SELECT with 379 options (placeholder + 377 + __other__), Husada option renders 'name — 01-JK1-001'; selecting 'Kampus Lainnya' reveals field-institusi-other input which accepts text. Mobile 390x844: both admin Kampus menu and student registration selector have scrollWidth==clientWidth==390 (no page overflow — inner table wrapper scrolls independently via overflow-x-auto). Capitalization matching is done in CampusField via .trim().toLowerCase() comparison; verified selection maps to canonical option not __other__.
